config.title: Sphynx
config.java.home.description: Path to a JDK installation (the folder that contains `bin/javac`). Leave empty to use `javac`/`java` from your PATH.
config.java.style.description: Style of the starter code for new challenges. Both styles are always accepted when you run or submit, because only the output is checked. Use **Reset Code to Starter** to switch a challenge you already opened.
config.java.style.enum0: Java 25+ compact source files: void main() and IO.println (requires JDK 25 or newer)
config.java.style.enum1: Classic public class Main with public static void main(String[] args) and System.out.println (JDK 17+)
config.codeFolder.description: Folder where your solutions are saved (one sub-folder per challenge). Leave empty to use `sphynx/` inside the open workspace, or the extension's private storage when no folder is open.
config.extraChallengePaths.description: Extra folders containing challenges (same format as the built-in ones). Teachers can use this to hand out new challenges without rebuilding the extension.
config.ai.provider.description: Where **AI hints** come from. Run **Sphynx: Set Up AI Hints** for a guided setup. API keys are stored in VS Code's encrypted secret storage, not in settings.
config.ai.provider.enum0: AI hints are disabled (default). Nothing is sent anywhere.
config.ai.provider.enum1: Ollama running on this computer (free, private). https://ollama.com
config.ai.provider.enum2: LM Studio's local server on this computer (free, private). https://lmstudio.ai
config.ai.provider.enum3: Anthropic's Claude API with your own API key.
config.ai.provider.enum4: Any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, a school server…) with your own key.
config.ai.provider.enum5: A model already available in VS Code, such as GitHub Copilot.
config.ai.model.description: Model to use for AI hints. Leave empty for the default: `claude-opus-5-5` for Anthropic, the first installed model for Ollama/LM Studio, any available model for VS Code. Required for `openai-compatible`.
config.ai.baseUrl.description: API base URL for AI hints. Required for `openai-compatible` (e.g. `https://api.openai.com/v1`). Optional for the others (defaults: Ollama `http://localhost:11434/v1`, LM Studio `http://localhost:1234/v1`).
config.ai.responseLanguage.description: Language for AI hints, e.g. `Português` or `English`. Leave empty to use the language of Sphynx (`sphynx.language`).
config.language: Language of Sphynx: challenges, quizzes, exams, panels and messages. The Command Palette follows VS Code's own display language.
